zeffy.description: Zeffy empowers nonprofits with free and efficient fundraising, so they can focus on supporting their communities.

samara.name: Samara
samara.description: Solar energy platform for households, facilitating the transition to renewable energy through installation and maintenance services.

weefin.name: WeeFin
weefin.description: A sustainable fintech platform that helps financial institutions manage ESG data and sustainable investment strategies; notably expanded its client base and operations in Italy.

acture.name: Acture
acture.description: Acture is a specialized outsourced service provider for corporates and staffing agencies, supporting them to minimize the high costs and risks associated with employee absenteeism and to comply with complex (social security) regulation. The company offers complementary services including case management, intervention and reintegration programs, combined with an integrated insurance proposition. To complement its proposition, Acture recently added a tech-based wellbeing platform focused on absence prevention. Acture is headquartered in Nijmegen (NL), employing 390 FTE.

valcon.name: Valcon
valcon.description: Valcon is a European provider of Consulting, Data and Technology services for digital transformation and automation projects for customers in the Netherlands, UK, and Nordics. Valcon serves leading European enterprise customers, with a particular focus on 5 end market verticals: Financial Services, Industrials, Infra & Transport, Public and Retail. Valcon is headquartered in Utrecht, NL and has 7 offices across Denmark, Sweden and the UK, supported by inhouse nearshoring hubs in Serbia and Croatia. Valcon employs over 1,600 FTEs.

crowe foederer.name: Crowe Foederer
crowe foederer.description: Crowe Foederer is a Dutch top-20 full-service audit & advisory firm and member of global accounting network Crowe Global, focusing on audit & assurance, financial advisory, tax advisory, HR services, corporate finance and IT services. The Company serves a diversified base of >5,3k (larger) SMEs and mid-market customers across various industries who prefer one partner for multiple (specialist) advisory services, leading to high customer intimacy and -loyalty. Crowe Foederer is headquartered in Eindhoven and operates 7 other offices in the Netherlands, employing c. 660 FTEs.

intero integrity services.name: Intero Integrity Services
intero integrity services.description: Intero is a technology-enabled asset inspection services specialist focused on the processing infrastructure, utilities and critical infrastructure, providing in-line inspection services for difficult-to-inspect pipelines using in-house developed inspection technologies. In addition, Intero provides environmental services (e.g. emission monitoring and pipe management) and industrial maintenance services, essential for the maintenance cycle of critical and processing infrastructure assets. Intero is headquartered in Tricht (NL), with technology centers in Europe and North America and local field operation teams globally, with a total workforce of 509 employees.

perbility.name: PERBILITY
perbility.description: PERBILITY is a provider of cloud-native and subscription-based human capital management (HCM) software. The Company’s HELIX solution addresses the entire employee lifecycle from talent acquisition, learning and development, HR admin to organizational planning and related analytics. high degree of configuration targeting 2,000+ customers in the financial services, (semi-)public and B2B sector in Germany. Headquartered in Bamberg (Germany), PERBILITY employs c.160 FTE across six offices in Germany and its nearshoring center in Turkey.

wilvo.name: Wilvo Group
wilvo.description: Wilvo Group is a leading provider of precision engineered metal components, assemblies and transportation systems to high-tech OEMs in attractive, fast-growing end-markets including semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, medtech, textile, and packaging. Wilvo is recognized as highly reliable production partner focusing on high-mix, low volume series having a long-standing (average c. 20 years) and recurring customer base (c. 98%) with single source relationships (c. 99%) on the back of customer intimacy and co-engineering relationships. Wilvo employs c. 520 FTE and is headquartered in Bergeijk, the Netherlands.

dataciders.name: Dataciders
dataciders.description: Dataciders is a leading IT services group offering end-to-end (“E2E”) data and analytics (“D&A”) solutions, primarily serving long-standing enterprise customers incl. DAX40 companies. The group’s E2E D&A capabilities cover data strategy, enterprise application integration, software engineering, data management, business intelligence and analytics, as well as data science and AI. Headquartered in Dortmund (Germany), Dataciders employs more than 500 FTEs across seven locations in Germany and one nearshoring location in Sofia (Bulgaria).

green mobility.name: Green Mobility Holding
green mobility.description: Green Mobility Holding is one of Europe’s leading technology-based (e-)bike leasing groups, providing bike leasing services to companies and their employees. With its different brands, Green Mobility Holding ensures an all-encompassing carefree service by providing corporate customers with a tailored company bike portal for the selection of (e-)bikes, as well as a proprietary service network. Green Mobility Holding is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and employs more than 200 employees across over 10 locations.

ced.name: CED
ced.description: CED is a pan-European leader in expert advice and claims management services, serving the insurance industry as well as the (semi-public) sector. Over the years, the Company has diversified its profile, being active across the claims value chain, in the property, mobility and vitality end markets and with a presence in key European geographies. With customer relations spanning decades, CED has proven to be a reliable partner to its blue-chip customer base.

2connect.name: 2Connect
2connect.description: 2Connect is a leading European provider of interconnection solutions for critical applications in demanding industries like semiconductor, off-highway, medtech, and high-tech machine building. The company designs, produces and assembles customized cables and connectors, with a focus on high mix, low volume batches, supplying mission-critical components with a high cost of failure. With customer relations spanning decades, 2Connect has proven to be a reliable partner to the most exacting customers.

mbk fincom.name: MBK Fincom
mbk fincom.description: MBK is a strongly growing, pan-European e-commerce player with an innovative business model that allows to leverage its own digital brands through data-driven tools. The Company co-designs its own-brand products and makes a rigorous value-for-money product selection across a broad range of categories including home furniture, above ground pools, beach accessories, garden & patio furniture, sports & fitness and others. The product portfolio includes 29 own brands as well as a variety of third-party brands, which are distributed through both MBK’s own channel ProduceShop as well as third-party marketplaces. MBK is headquartered near Lugano, Switzerland, and is active across 24 countries, including Italy, France, Germany, Spain, Austria and Switzerland.

agilitas.name: Agilitas Group
agilitas.description: Agilitas Group (formerly t-groep) is an HR solutions provider focused on temporary staffing in Belgium and the Netherlands. General temporary staffing makes up c. 70% of sales with the remainder coming from staffing in the cultural sector, service vouchers and HR consulting. The Company is active through 74 offices in the Belgian market with the balance of sales being generated in the Netherlands where Agilitas operates 66 offices.

init ag f r digitale kommunikation.name: ]init[ AG für digitale Kommunikation
init ag f r digitale kommunikation.description: ]init[is a leading German IT services provider focusing on digitization projects in the public sector as well as in the regulated private sector. The company’s end-to-end services offering covers strategy & consulting, experience & content, platform & application development, and managed services & operations. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, the ]init[ Group operates seven office locations across Germany, Belgium and Switzerland with more than 1,000 FTE.

tonerpartner.name: TonerPartner
tonerpartner.description: TonerPartner is one of Europe’s leading online retailers specialised in the marketing of ink, toner, and printer cartridges for a wide range of printers in 16 European countries. The company offers one of the broadest portfolios of original branded products, high quality white label and own branded compatible alternatives, as well as environmentally friendly recycled products. TonerPartner has a loyal and growing end customer base with more than 4 million B2B and B2C customers served in recent years.

eichholtz.name: Eichholtz
eichholtz.description: Eichholtz is a well-known design brand and wholesaler of luxury furniture collections. Eichholtz sells its collections worldwide through interior design professionals, hospitality specialists and a wide range of retailers including specialists, monobrand stores, shop-in-shop and e-tailers. Customers are offered a one-stop-shop experience with a wide range of SKUs across multiple product categories (furniture, lighting, accessories and outdoor) and with different styles. Eichholtz operates an asset light business model and is headquartered in Noordwijkerhout (NL) where it has a grand showroom and warehouse, with additional showrooms in High Point (US) and Amsterdam (NL). In addition, Eichholtz has partnerships with dozens of Eichholtz monobrand stores that are located around the world.

ace pharmaceuticals.name: Ace Pharmaceuticals
ace pharmaceuticals.description: Ace Pharmaceuticals (Ace) is a leading independent pharmaceutical company operating in the niche market of medical need products to satisfy the unmet demand of small patient groups. By doing this, the company makes a valuable contribution to society. Via its state-of-the-art facility, Ace carries out the development, production, and distribution of its products. In addition, Ace manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical compounded products for pharmacies.

staedean.name: STAEDEAN
staedean.description: STAEDEAN is a leading developer of SaaS business application software based on Microsoft ERP solutions for the manufacturing, life sciences and equipment rental verticals. It serves a global (45+ countries) and diversified (2.2k+) customer base, primarily through a network of channel partners. As an Inner Circle Partner (top 1%) for 19+ years, STAEDEAN is widely recognized as a top 5 global independent software vendor (ISV) in the Microsoft ecosystem.

tas.name: TAS
tas.description: TAS is a leading developer of software solutions and services for a niche of the financial services sector, focusing on card management, interbank payments, capital markets and open banking (PSD2). It provides mission critical software solutions linking into the core banking platforms of c.90% of all Italian financial institutions, as well as professional services related to ongoing maintenance, new regulation, and implementations. Besides Italy, TAS has operations across Europe with a specific focus on DACH and Eastern Europe.

edco.name: EDCO
edco.description: EDCO is a leading and fast-growing distributor of value- and branded non-food FMCG products to a wide variety of retailers. Products and services are offered to a broad customer base (+3k customers) consisting of different archetype retailers including food discounters, discount non-food, super/hyper markets, small independents, specialists and e-commerce. Over the last years, EDCO has transformed from a family led, trading business to a value-added (multicategory) distributor with a significantly increased focus on brands and retail concepts.

tencate grass.name: TenCate Grass
tencate grass.description: TenCate Grass (“TCGrass”) is the global leader in the design, manufacture, distribution and installation of artificial turf solutions for both sports and landscaping. The Company operates a vertically integrated business model from grass yarn extrusion and backing fabrics manufacturing (“Upstream”) extending through turf manufacturing (tufting, weaving) and distribution (“Midstream”), through to end product installation and maintenance (“Downstream”), serving a globally diversified customer base at each level of the value chain, which consists of leading tufting & distribution companies, landscaping and sports installers and product end users.

corilus.name: Corilus
corilus.description: Corilus is the market leader in Belgium in integrated healthcare software and IT solutions for a wide range of medical and paramedical professionals including general practitioners, dentists, elderly homes, physiotherapists, nurses, pharmacies, etc. The Company’s software solutions aim to facilitate increased efficiency in the day-to-day administrative and clinical operations as well as collaboration across stakeholders (e.g. caretakers, hospitals). Corilus offers its solutions to over 13,000 clients, representing over 40,000 users.

xd connects.name: XD Connects
xd connects.description: XD Connects is a leading designer and value-added supplier of sustainable business gifts, serving over 5,000 B2B-distributors, mainly in Europe. XD Connects has two main goals: becoming a CO2 neutral company in 2030 through carbon offsetting, and more importantly continuously reducing the CO2 footprint in both its product collection and operations. Headquartered in Rijswijk, the Netherlands, XD Connects operates an inhouse printing and fulfillment center in Romania, as well as a design studio and sourcing office in Shanghai. The company markets its products through a network of sales entities globally, focusing on the European market.

tencate geosynthetics.name: TenCate Geosynthetics
tencate geosynthetics.description: TenCate Geosynthetics is the global leading manufacturer of geotextiles, with applications in civil works, infrastructure and water & environment as well as niche applications in industrial fabrics. Products are used for separation, drainage and filtration purposes, as well as erosion and shoreline protection, land reclamation and reinforcement of dikes and dams. The Company employs +1,400 FTE across 8 manufacturing facilities in North America (2 incl. HQ), Europe (3) and Asia (3). TenCate Geosynthetics was sold to Solmax in May 2021.

tencate advanced armour.name: TenCate Advanced Armour
tencate advanced armour.description: TenCate Advanced Armour (“TCAA”) develops and produces lightweight composites and ceramic materials for ballistic protection of personnel and vehicles, aircraft and ships in the key end-markets defence and law enforcement. Main products are tailormade spall liner and add-on armour kits for various parts of vehicles, helicopters, and airplanes as well as a wide range of high spec ballistic plates for body armour (vests, shields).

enstall.name: Enstall
enstall.description: Enstall is the global leading developer and distributor of solar panel mounting systems for both residential and commercial roofs. Its in-house R&D team develops innovative and user-friendly systems, characterized by their ease to install and reliability. Production is outsourced to third parties and products are subsequently distributed to wholesalers, EPC contractors, solar integrators or installers directly.

powerlines.name: Powerlines
powerlines.description: Engineering provider for energy technology infrastructure

muon.name: Muon
muon.description: Muon is a global leader in mission-critical micro precision solutions functioning at the heart of end user applications in healthcare, semiconductor, digital printing and filtration. With its comprehensive portfolio of miniaturization technologies, consisting of electroforming, micromechanical and thermal processing, chemical etching and laser material processing, Muon is uniquely positioned to supply these components to the world’s most demanding, high-tech OEMs.

kinkelder.name: KINKELDER
kinkelder.description: KINKELDER is a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-quality circular saw blades applied in industrial high-speed steel cutting processes and is the global leader in this market. KINKELDER produces blades in three locations in Europe and the US, from which it exports to over 70 countries. The company has an unmatched reputation for high quality & service and a continuous focus on innovation.

elcee.name: ELCEE
elcee.description: ELCEE is a leading supplier of customized parts and components, assembled products and standard products for a wide range of industrial markets. The company is active in the (co-)development, design, engineering and supply chain management (sourcing, stock-keeping as well as quality control and delivery) of industrial parts in four product groups: castings and forgings, plain bearings, fasteners, and lifters. ELCEE operates local offices throughout Europe in combination with technical support centers in China and Poland.

znd.name: ZND
znd.description: ZND is a leading manufacturer of temporary fences (panels and barriers) for construction and event markets. The Company runs a highly efficient and fully automated production process and sell to distributors and rental companies arround the globe. ZND is a market leader in the United States and various European countries with production facilities in the US (2), the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Poland.

storio.name: Storio
storio.description: The merger of albelli and Photobox (completed Jan ‘22) has established the leading B2C e-commerce photo products & gifting business in Europe: Storio group. The group supplies high-quality photobooks and other related photo print products such as wall décor, cards, calendars, prints and goodies to millions of customers via highly recognized local brands and strong market positions across the Benelux, UK, France, Spain, Germany and Scandinavia as well as other European countries. Storio group operates a vertically integrated business model, combining e-commerce with inhouse printing and photo creation software, but also collaborates with networked external factories.

tencate advanced composites.name: TenCate Advanced Composites
tencate advanced composites.description: TenCate Advanced Composites (“TCAC”) is a leading global producer of advanced thermoplastic (TP) and thermoset (TS) composites. TCAC supplies TP composites to commercial aviation programs including Airbus and Boeing who are increasingly replacing traditional materials with TP as a means of reducing costs and enabling higher build rates on current and next-generation programs. In addition, TCAC has leading positions in high-value, attractive niche TS markets including Space & Communications and Industrial end-markets (specialty automotive). The Company employs over 700 FTE globally and operates manufacturing facilities in North America (3 incl. HQ), Europe (2), and Asia (1). TenCate Advanced Composites was sold to Toray in July 2018.

tencate protective fabrics.name: TenCate Protective Fabrics
tencate protective fabrics.description: TenCate Protective Fabrics designs, develops, manufactures, sources and sells fabrics used by garment makers for high-performance (protective) clothing. The fabrics provide protection against flame, heat, molten metal, chemical and other acids, achieved by strong know-how in blending fibres to incorporate, often patented, functionalities. TCPF is active in four segments; Industrial Safety (US, EMEA & APAC), Emergency Response (US, EMEA & APAC), Military (US, EMEA & APAC), and Workwear (EMEA).

tencate.name: TenCate (Group/Holding)
tencate.description: TenCate is a Dutch industrial conglomerate active in various areas of the technical textiles and composite materials universe. The group comprises five market groups active in (aero)space composites, antiballistics & armour, protective fabrics, synthetic grass and geosynthetics that operate largely on a stand-alone basis, supplying different products into different end markets. The holding is headquartered in the Netherlands with the individual (head-)offices and production sites located globally.

The innovative product portfolio combines own brands in US and Europe with regional distribution agreements with major OTC players.

best4tires.name: Best4Tires
best4tires.description: Best4Tires is a digitally enabled leader in the B2B aftermarket distribution of tires, rims, completely fitted wheels and related services to car dealerships and wholesalers in Germany with a superior logistics expertise and network. Additionally, Best4Tires provides wheel assembly services to blue-chip car OEMs in Europe. Operations are based in Germany, Austria, Hungary, Slovak Republic, Sweden and the Netherlands. The group has shown consistent historical growth and is uniquely positioned in the market having a broad, deep and loyal customer base.
